patterns.usage_note: Formal letter-and-greeting Japanese for an occasion framed as a welcome opportunity: 帰国の折に, お立ち寄りの折に. It attaches to a dictionary- or た-form verb, an i-adjective, or N+の, and polite requests in ください follow it freely. Sibling 際に is the neutral procedural "when you do X" and takes accidents and prohibitions; 折 keeps the sense of "should the chance arise", though adverse ongoing states are fine (お忙しい折に).

examples.ruby: 祖父[そふ]の家[いえ]を訪[おとず]れた折[おり]に、古[ふる]い写真[しゃしん]を見[み]つけた。
examples.english: When I paid my grandfather's house a visit, I came across some old photographs.

examples.ruby: ご帰国[きこく]の折[おり]に、ぜひご連絡[れんらく]ください。
examples.english: Do get in touch when you're back in the country.

examples.ruby: 来春[らいしゅん]そちらへ伺[うかが]う折[おり]に、お目[め]にかかれれば幸[さいわ]いです。
examples.english: I would be delighted to see you when I come your way next spring.

patterns.usage_note: Presents the prevailing season or conditions as the backdrop for the concern or event that follows, which makes it a fixture of seasonal greetings: 寒さ厳しい折から、ご自愛ください. The adnominal 折からの modifies a noun with the sense of what happened to be falling or blowing at the time (折からの雨). Sibling 折に points at a chance to do something, 折から at circumstances being lived through. It is typically non-past.

examples.ruby: 梅雨[つゆ]の折[おり]から、どうぞご自愛[じあい]ください。
examples.english: With the rainy season upon us, please do take care of yourself.

examples.ruby: 寒[さむ]さ厳[きび]しい折[おり]から、皆様[みなさま]のご健康[けんこう]をお祈[いの]りします。
examples.english: In this season of bitter cold, I wish you all continued good health.

examples.ruby: 折[おり]からの雨[あめ]で運動会[うんどうかい]は取[と]りやめになった。
examples.english: The rain that had set in just then got sports day called off.

patterns.usage_note: The neutral formal "when" of announcements, manuals, forms, and business speech: 機械を使用する際に, 事故の際には. It attaches to a dictionary- or た-form verb or to N+の, and it is indifferent to whether the occasion is welcome, so warnings and prohibitions are normal after it. Sibling 折に keeps the flavour of a welcome opportunity. It prefers occasions worth singling out and sounds starched on daily trivia (歯を磨く時).

examples.ruby: 機械[きかい]を使用[しよう]する際[さい]に、必[かなら]ず手袋[てぶくろ]をつけてください。
examples.english: When operating the machine, be sure to put on gloves.

examples.ruby: 口座[こうざ]を開[ひら]いた際[さい]に、印鑑[いんかん]の登録[とうろく]も済[す]ませた。
examples.english: When I opened the account, I got the seal registration out of the way too.

examples.ruby: 面接[めんせつ]の際[さい]に、志望[しぼう]動機[どうき]を詳[くわ]しく聞[き]かれた。
examples.english: At the interview they questioned me closely about why I wanted the job.
